## Exercises 18.3.4  {.unnumbered}

### Question 1

> Can you find any relationship between the carrier and the rows that appear to be missing from planes?

**Solution:**

> The code below reveals that the missing planes almost entirely belong to `American Airlines` (AA) and` Envoy Air` (MQ).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)

flights |> 
  distinct(tailnum, carrier) |> 
  anti_join(planes) |> 
  count(carrier, sort = TRUE)
```
